questions.stem: If my car breaks down, what shall I do with it?

options.D: Make it into a new one.

questions.explain: Break down 故障

questions.stem: On her way to school yesterday morning, she saw the accident happen. When did the accident happen?
questions.explain:
on one's way: 在前往...的途中
accident: 意外事故
happen: 發生
解析：題目問車禍「何時」發生。句中提到昨天早上目睹意外，故答案選C。選項A與B回答的是地點而非時間；選項D將時間改成前天，與句意不符。

questions.stem: A: Are you sure her narration is accurate? B: Yes, her story is______ .

turns.t: Are you sure her narration is accurate?
Yes, her story is______ .

questions.explain:
narration: 敘述、陳述
accurate: 精確的、正確的
faulty: 有缺點的、錯誤的
解析：男士詢問是否確定她的敘述很準確（accurate），女士給予肯定回答，空格需填入同義詞，故答案選A。correct 與 accurate 意思相同，皆指「正確的」。干擾選項 B（虛假的）與 D（有錯誤的）皆為反義詞，C（虛構創新的）則與事實查核的語意不合。

questions.stem: When do you think the plane will take off?
questions.explain: Take off :起飛 根據題意 答案選C

questions.stem: What’s the capacity of the theater?
questions.explain:
capacity: 容量、容納人數
theater: 劇院、電影院
解析：題意問劇院的容納量是多少。capacity用於建築或場所時指可容納的人數，故答案選B。干擾選項A英呎為長度單位、C加侖為液體容量單位、D為金額，皆不符合計算場地容納人數的用法。

questions.stem: How long does it take to fly from Seattle to New Orleans?

options.A: It depends on by train or by plane.
options.B: It is about three to four hours.

questions.explain:
How long: 多久（詢問時間）
take: 花費（時間）
depend on: 取決於
解析：題目問搭機要花「多久時間」。「How long does it take」詢問時間長短，故答案選B。選項C回答哩程、D回答距離，皆為詢問距離（How far）的干擾陷阱；選項A則忽略題目已限定搭飛機（fly），不合邏輯。

questions.stem: Who’s going to entertain our guests from Orlando?

options.A: The R & D team will spoil the party.
options.B: The PR department will throw a party.
options.C: The Secretariat will cancel the meeting.
options.D: The President will give a talk.

questions.explain: entertain (v.): 招待, throw a party= to have a party 開派對, 根據題意 答案選B

questions.stem: The price of oil keeps rising. Last week it was four dollars per liter. This week you have to pay a quarter more. How much is the price per liter now?
questions.explain:
quarter 這裡是美元硬幣 25分 / A quarter more “超過 25美分硬幣” ,所以最接
近題意的答案為選項 C

questions.stem: Ted has lived overseas for more than a decade. How long has Ted been abroad?
questions.explain: A decade : 10年, more than 超過 所以答案選B

questions.stem: How did Fred get along with his new studies?

options.D: D. He just bought a new car.

questions.explain: Get along (ph.) 相處融洽

questions.stem: What number is between 11 and 13?
questions.explain:
between: 在……之間
twelve: 十二
解析：題意問「哪一個數字在11和13之間？」。11與13中間的數字是12，英文為twelve，因此答案選B。其餘選項A（16）、C（14）與D（20）均不在區間內，其中C選項fourteen等帶有teen字尾的數字為常見數字干擾項，切勿混淆。

questions.stem: Which of these items would you keep in a refrigerator?
questions.explain:
refrigerator: 冰箱
keep: 存放、保存
item: 物品
解析：題意為「你會把哪項物品存放在冰箱裡？」。冰箱用於低溫保鮮，常理下只有食物需要冷藏，故答案選C。選項A衣服、B雨傘與D動物皆非冷藏物品，完全不合生活常識，純屬邏輯干擾選項。

questions.stem: I don’t think your solution will work.
questions.explain: work (v.) 有效,成功 題目 “我認為你的解決方案不會有用” 所以答案選B

questions.stem: You certainly would bother them if you should call them early Sunday morning.
questions.explain: Bother (V.)使擔心 Disturb (v.) 干擾, 根據題意 答案選B

questions.stem: Tom said he was available this afternoon.
questions.explain:
available (adj.) “有空的”, he is not busy and be able to do something /
Engaged (adj.) “忙於某件事” busy doing something

questions.stem: When you describe the event, don’t leave out the details.

options.A: You need to add new details.
options.B: You need to omit the details.
options.C: You need to include the details.
options.D: You need to forget the details.

questions.explain: leave out: 忽略

questions.stem: The sign says “Caution”. What does it mean?
questions.explain: Caution (n.) 小心,謹慎

questions.stem: Bill said his van can sit as many as 7 people. What did Bill talk about?
questions.explain: Capacity (n.) 容量,容積

questions.stem: Stick to your studies and you’ll amount to something.
questions.explain:
Amount to: 等於, become, 題目 “堅持你的學習，你會有所作為。” 所以最接
近題意的答案為D

questions.stem: He’s developed a negative attitude toward life.

options.A: He looks at the bright side of life.

questions.explain:
negative attitude: 負面態度
pessimistic: 悲觀的
look at the bright side: 看光明面
解析：題意為「他對人生抱持負面態度」。negative attitude 即悲觀之意，故答案選D。干擾選項A（看光明面）為相反的樂觀意思；選項B（健康差）與C（窮困）則是將「負面」過度推論至健康或經濟狀況的字面陷阱。

questions.stem: The swimming pool is open to the public. Who can use it?
questions.explain:
open to the public: 對大眾開放
anybody: 任何人
public: 公眾、民眾
解析：題意為「這座游泳池對大眾開放，誰可以使用？」片語 open to the public 表示所有人都能使用，故答案選B。選項A（沒有人）與D（僅少數人）語意與開放相反；選項C（某人）意思過於狹隘特定，不符合公眾皆可使用的概念。

questions.stem: Bob is an efficient mechanic.

options.C: He does his work quickly and well.
options.D: He doesn’t care about his work.

questions.explain:
efficient: 有效率的
mechanic: 機械師、技工
poorly: 糟糕地、貧乏地
解析：題意指鮑伯是位有效率的技工。efficient 表示做事迅速且優良，故答案選C。干擾項選項B的 poorly（差勁地）為反義詞陷阱；選項A（愛抱怨）與選項D（不在乎工作）皆屬無關的負面語意干擾。

questions.stem: The man said he couldn’t put up with their behavior anymore. What does he mean?
questions.explain:
Put up with: 忍受, 題目 “那個男人說他再也忍受不了他們的行為了。” 所以答
案選C

questions.stem: Excuse me, where is the main station? What’s the man asking?
questions.explain:
excuse me: 不好意思、請問
main station: 總站、主車站
ask for directions: 問路、詢問方向
解析：男子詢問「不好意思，總站在哪裡？」，是在詢問特定地點的位置與路線，即「問路」，因此答案選A。選項D「火車時刻表」為車站情境的聯想陷阱，題幹問的是地點而非出發時間；B與C則語意不合。

questions.stem: Jane was invited to the ceremony but she declined the invitation.
questions.explain: Decline (v) 拒絕

questions.stem: I wish I had been there when she beat her rival.

options.B: I didn’t see how she won the game.
options.C: I knew when she won the game.
options.D: She didn’t want me to be there.

questions.explain: beat her rival “擊敗她的對手”

questions.stem: John is too mature and sophisticated for his age.
questions.explain: Too… for 對 太 樣 題目”約翰對他的年齡來說過於成熟和世故。”

questions.stem: Harry was informed of his misdeeds.
questions.explain: Misdeeds: 劣跡

questions.stem: Nancy works in an ICU in a nearby hospital.
questions.explain: 從hospital ICU (醫院加護病房)得知Nancy 應該是在醫院工作, 所以答案選A

questions.stem: Utility bills are paid monthly.

options.B: They are paid in the same amount.
options.C: They are paid every two months.
options.D: They are paid half the price.

questions.explain: Utility bills:水電費 monthly: 每個月的

questions.stem: The teacher said this composition still leaves much to be desired. What does he mean?
questions.explain: Leave much to be desired: 還有很大改進餘地

questions.stem: Hurry up or you’ll miss the shuttle bus.

options.B: You need to get up early.

questions.explain: miss (v.) 錯過

questions.stem: The counter will begin at 7 o’clock in the evening.
questions.explain:
begin: 開始
resume: 重新開始、恢復
解析：題意為「櫃檯將在晚間七點開始」。begin 與 start 為同義字，皆表示「開始」，故答案選C。干擾選項 A 的 close 與 D 的 end 意思相反，皆為「結束、關閉」；B 的 resume 則是「中斷後重新開始」，不符合原本單純開始的意思。

questions.stem: The post office was just across the street, right on the corner.

options.C: It’s on the right hand side.

questions.explain:
across the street: 在街對面
opposite: 在…對面
right on the corner: 就在轉角處
解析：題意為「郵局就在街對面，正好在轉角處」。across the street與opposite同義，皆表示在街道對面，故答案選A。干擾項B說離數英哩遠與題意相反；C將表「正好」的副詞right誤導為「右手邊」的字面陷阱；D則無中生有加入closed（關閉）。

questions.stem: The boy found the box too heavy to lift.

options.C: He could move the box away.

questions.explain: Too… to 太... 而不能

questions.stem: David has been ill for two weeks and that’s why he was absent from classes yesterday.

options.B: David has been absent from classes for two weeks.

questions.explain:
be absent from: 缺席
attend: 出席、參加
解析：題意為大衛病了兩週，這就是他昨天缺課的原因。be absent from 等同於 not attend，故答案選C。干擾項部分：A選項與題意相反；B選項混淆時間細節，他是生病兩週而非缺席兩週；D選項稱他不喜歡上課則是無中生有的陷阱。

questions.stem: Sarah wanted to know what the shelf contains. What did she want to know?
questions.explain: Contain (v.) 包含

questions.stem: The two brothers are quite alike.

options.D: They don’t want to be together.

questions.explain: Resemble (v.) 與....相似 根據題意 答案選A

questions.stem: Don’t give up until you’ve tried all methods.
questions.explain: Give up: 放棄 根據題意 答案選 D perseverant 執著

questions.stem: He has to deal with complaints from customers all over the world. What department is he in?
questions.explain:
deal with: 處理
complaint: 抱怨、投訴
customer service: 客戶服務
解析：題意為他必須處理來自全球顧客的抱怨，詢問他在哪個部門。處理顧客投訴是客服的核心業務，故答案選C。干擾選項均為常見部門，A為國軍常接觸的後勤物流、B為會計、D為人力資源，皆非第一線對外處理顧客抱怨的單位。

questions.stem: If the machine is automatic, ______________.

options.D: it is part of a factory.

questions.explain:
automatic: 自動的
by itself: 自動地、靠自己
operate by hand: 手動操作
解析：題意為「如果這台機器是自動的……」。答案選A，因 automatic 表示不需人力介入、能自行運轉（works by itself）。干擾選項 C「手動操作」意思完全相反；B 產生噪音與 D 是工廠的一部分，皆與詞義無關。

questions.stem: Sally was puzzled at her next step to take.

options.A: She knew what to do next.
options.B: She was unsure of her next move.
options.D: She had a few more steps to ascend.

questions.explain: Puzzled (adj.) 困惑

questions.stem: Betty is on maternity leave, and that’s why she still gets paid.
questions.explain: maternity leave:產假

questions.stem: We aim to provide healthy food at fair prices. The prices are _____.
questions.explain: fair (adj.) 公平的 reasonable (adj.)合理的

questions.stem: Nancy selected a necktie for her husband.
questions.explain:
select: 挑選、選擇
necktie: 領帶
choose: 選擇
解析：題意為 Nancy 為先生挑選了一條領帶。動詞 select 與 choose 為同義詞，故答案選D。干擾項 B 的 found（找到）與 C 的 looked for（尋找）混淆了購物動作的階段與含義；A 則與題意相反。

questions.stem: It takes 30 minutes to record the tape.

options.A: The recording will start in 30 minutes.
options.B: The tape recorder will be available in 30 minutes long.
options.D: The tape speed is 30 feet per minute.

questions.explain:
take time: 花費時間
record: 錄音、錄製
recording: 錄音、錄音長度
解析：題意指錄製這卷錄音帶需耗時30分鐘，代表該錄音長度就是30分鐘，故答案選C。干擾項A誤解為「30分鐘後才開始」，B混淆為「錄音機何時可用」，D選項則牽強附會扯到「每分鐘轉速30英尺」，皆扭曲原句花費時間的意涵。

questions.stem: I don’t know whether Jane will come.

options.A: I don’t know when she will come.
options.B: I don’t know why she will come.
options.C: I don’t know how she will come.
options.D: I don’t know if she will come.

questions.explain:
whether: 是否
if: 是否
解析：原句題意為「我不知道珍是否會來」。連接詞 whether 與 if 引導名詞子句時皆表示「是否」，語意相同可直接代換，因此答案選D。選項 A 的 when（何時）、B 的 why（為什麼）及 C 的 how（如何）皆為不同的疑問副詞，改變了原句語意，屬於常見的疑問詞混淆陷阱。

questions.stem: Anne glanced at her watch. What was she doing?

options.C: She took a quick look at it.

questions.explain: Glance (v.) 迅速地看一眼

questions.stem: You can get an early bird discount if you buy tickets well in advance.

options.A: The early bird catches the worm.
options.B: The second mouse gets the cheese.
options.D: It’s never too late to mend.

questions.explain:
Early bird discount 早鳥優惠 / The early bird catches the worm: 早起的鳥兒
有蟲吃 / More haste, less speed.: 欲速則不達。所以最接近題意的答案為A

questions.stem: Make hay while the sun shines. What does it mean?
questions.explain:
題目Make hay while the sun shines.: to make good use of an opportunity
while it lasts (打鐵趁熱，勿失良機) Seize (v.) 把握

questions.stem: It was only recently that Jack knew he was cut out for architecture.

options.A: Jack was not good at architecture.

questions.explain: Be cut out for (ph.)有….才能

questions.stem: I’d rather have coffee. What does he mean?
questions.explain: Would rather : 䌀可

questions.stem: The weather looks dark and gloomy. There might be showers and thunderstorms.

options.C: There will be no clouds today.

questions.explain:
gloomy: 陰暗的
shower: 陣雨
thunderstorm: 雷雨
解析：題意為天氣陰暗沉悶，可能會有陣雨和雷雨。句中提到陣雨與雷雨，表示今天會下雨，因此答案選D。選項A（不會下雨）、B（陽光普照）及C（萬里無雲）都與題幹描述的壞天氣相反，屬於語意完全顛倒的干擾項。

questions.stem: The company has recently hired more than 20 new employees.
questions.explain: Expand (v.) 擴大 題目 “該公司最近僱用了20多名新員工。”根據題意 答案選B

questions.stem: He should have taken our advice.

options.B: We didn’t want to give him advice.
options.C: He turned a deaf ear to our advice.
options.D: He thought our advice was good.

questions.explain:
題目”他應該接受我們的建議。” 根據題意 答案選C “他對我們的建議置若罔
聞。”

questions.stem: After trying to rescue the ship, the captain finally gave an order to abandon it.
questions.explain:
rescue: 救援
abandon: 放棄、拋棄
give up: 放棄
解析：題意為船長在嘗試救援後，最終下達棄船命令。動詞 abandon 與 give up 意思相同，皆為「放棄」，故答案選B。選項A的 saved（拯救）與棄船意思相反；選項C的 boarded（登船）與 D的 burned（燒毀）皆扭曲字義，屬於錯誤推論。

questions.stem: M: Have you made the appointment with the doctor? W: Yes, I am supposed to see him this afternoon. Q: What did they talk about?

turns.t: Have you made the appointment with the doctor?
Yes, I am supposed to see him this afternoon.
What did they talk about?

questions.explain:
make an appointment: 預約掛號
be supposed to: 預計、應該
解析：男士詢問是否已向醫生預約看診，女士回答預計下午去，問兩人在討論什麼。對話重點在於看診的預約行程，故答案選B。選項A討論醫生、C討論醫療建議、D討論治療，皆為延伸醫學詞彙的字面干擾陷阱，對話並未深入談及這些內容。

questions.stem: M: Am I supposed to use chopsticks... or just forks and knives? W: When in Rome, do as the Romans do. Q: What does the woman mean?

options.D: Rome wasn’t built in a day.

turns.t: Am I supposed to use chopsticks... or just forks and knives?
When in Rome, do as the Romans do.
What does the woman mean?

questions.explain: When in Rome, do as the Romans do. “入境隨俗”

questions.stem: M: Why were you absent from work yesterday? W: I had a bad cold and went to see a doctor. Q: What happened to the woman?

turns.t: Why were you absent from work yesterday?
I had a bad cold and went to see a doctor.
What happened to the woman?

questions.explain:
absent from work: 缺勤、沒上班
catch a cold: 感冒
see a doctor: 看醫生
解析：男士詢問女士昨天為何沒上班，女士說重感冒去看醫生。問女士怎麼了，had a cold同義替換為caught a cold，故答案選B。選項A以doctor設下字面陷阱，她是去看病而非醫生；C被開除與D沒在聽皆非事實。

questions.stem: Man: I just heard that Mr. Parker from accounting was promoted to the head of the finance division. Woman: Yeah, I heard that too. What change do you think he will make? Question: What did they talk about?

turns.t: I just heard that Mr. Parker from accounting was promoted to the head of the finance division.
Yeah, I heard that too. What change do you think he will make?
What did they talk about?

questions.explain: Promote (v.) 晉升 Promotion (n.) 升遷 complaints (n.) 抱怨

questions.stem: W: I feel like having some dessert, how about you? M: I’m Okay. I still have this glass of wine to finish. Q: What did the woman want?

turns.t: I feel like having some dessert, how about you?
I’m Okay. I still have this glass of wine to finish.
What did the woman want?

questions.explain:
feel like: 想要
dessert: 甜點
glass of wine: 一杯酒
解析：女士明確表示想吃點甜點（feel like having some dessert），問女士想要什麼，故答案選C。干擾選項A是男士手上還沒喝完的酒，並非女士想要的東西；B與D在對話中完全未提及，屬於無中生有的陷阱。

questions.stem: W: Does bus number 100 go to the subway station? M: No, but I can give you a transfer. Q: What could the man be?

turns.t: Does bus number 100 go to the subway station?
No, but I can give you a transfer.
What could the man be?

questions.explain: Transfer (n.) 轉乘

questions.stem: W: May I have your flight schedule, ticket confirmation number, and passport, please? M: Here they are. Q: Where did the conversation most likely take place?

turns.t: May I have your flight schedule, ticket confirmation number, and passport, please?
Here they are.
Where did the conversation most likely take place?

questions.explain: the airport’s checking counter: 機場報到櫃檯 convenience store:便利店

questions.stem: M: Excuse me. Where can I buy a money order? W: I’m sorry. Our bank doesn’t sell it. Q: Where did the conversation take place?

turns.t: Excuse me. Where can I buy a money order?
I’m sorry. Our bank doesn’t sell it.
Where did the conversation take place?

questions.explain: Money order: 匯票

questions.stem: W: Can you meet me at the food court? M: Yes, it’s very convenient. Q: What did the man say about the meeting place?

turns.t: Can you meet me at the food court?
Yes, it’s very convenient.
What did the man say about the meeting place?

questions.explain: Food court: 美食廣場

questions.stem: W: Does your company manufacture copying machines? M: Yes, we do. Q: What does the man do?

turns.t: Does your company manufacture copying machines?
Yes, we do.
What does the man do?

Since 的意思：不管是作為連接詞或是介系詞，since 的意思取決於句子結構
和時態。 Since 作為連接詞：附屬子句的動詞為過去式時，since 通常表示時
間。 在一個帶有 since 子句（since he was 12）的句子中，若主要動詞指涉
一段包含現在的期間，則該動詞必須為現在完成式。

questions.stem: If it _____ tomorrow, the game will be postponed.

單式，而主要子句是未來簡單式。

questions.stem: He requested a personal leave from the officer.
